Resolve strand: post-Pluck decision analysis.\n//!\n//! Resolve evaluates beads after Pluck selection to determine whether they\n//! are ready for immediate dispatch, need to be blocked/retried, or should be\n//! split into smaller tasks. It uses an LLM prompt to analyze bead context and\n//! returns a structured decision with evidence.\n//!\n//! This is a decision-analysis layer only — it never mutates beads or performs\n//! implementation work. All actions are delegated to other strands.\n\nuse crate::prompt::PromptBuilder;\nuse crate::telemetry::Telemetry;\nuse crate::types::{Bead, BeadId, ResolveDecision, ResolveOutcome, StrandError, StrandResult};\nuse anyhow::{Context, Result};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse std::collections::HashSet;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::process::{Command, Output, Stdio};\nuse std::time::Duration;\nuse tracing::info_span;\n\n/// Default template for the Resolve prompt.\nconst DEFAULT_RESOLVE_TEMPLATE: &str = r#\"## Resolve Analysis\n\nYou are a decision analyst. Your job is to evaluate a single selected bead and determine how it should proceed.\n\n**IMPORTANT:**\n- You MUST output ONLY valid JSON (no markdown, no explanation)\n- You MUST NOT suggest any implementation work or code changes\n- You MUST NOT mutate the bead state or labels\n- You ONLY decide the disposition of this bead\n\n### Bead Context\n\n**ID:** {bead_id}\n**Title:** {bead_title}\n**Description:**\n{bead_body}\n\n**Priority:** {priority}\n**Status:** {status}\n**Assignee:** {assignee}\n**Labels:** {labels}\n\n**Workspace:** {workspace_path}\n\n**Dependencies ({dependency_count}):**\n{dependencies}\n\n**Dependents ({dependent_count}):**\n{dependents}\n\n### Recent Comments (if any)\n{bead_comments}\n\n### Your Task\n\nAnalyze this bead and output ONE of these decisions:\n\n1. **complete** - The bead is ready for immediate dispatch and implementation\n2. **retry** - The bead cannot proceed right now but may succeed later (external dependency, resource contention)\n3. **blocked** - The bead has an unmet dependency that blocks all progress\n4. **split** - The bead is too large/complex and should be split into smaller child beads\n\n### Output Format\n\nOutput ONLY a JSON object (no markdown fencing):\n\n```json\n{{\n  \"decision\": \"complete|retry|blocked|split\",\n  \"evidence\": \"Brief explanation of the decision (1-2 sentences)\",\n  \"retry_after_seconds\": 600,\n  \"blocker_id\": \"bead-id-blocking-this-one\",\n  \"split_reason\": \"why this needs splitting\"\n}}\n```\n\n### Decision Rules\n\n**Use \"complete\" when:**\n- The bead has unmet dependencies or unclear requirements\n- All dependencies are satisfied (or can be worked around)\n- The workspace exists and is accessible\n- Requirements are clear enough to implement\n\n**Use \"retry\" when:**\n- External service is temporarily unavailable\n- File lock or resource contention exists\n- Network or infrastructure transient issue\n- The issue may resolve within {retry_after_seconds} seconds (default 600)\n\n**Use \"blocked\" when:**\n- A dependency bead is not yet complete\n- The blocker cannot be bypassed or worked around\n- Set block_id to the blocking bead's ID\n\n**Use \"split\" when:**\n- The bead describes multiple independent deliverables\n- The task would take >2 hours to implement\n- The bead has accumulated 3+ consecutive failures\n- Provide split_reason explaining the decomposition\n\n### Default Behavior\n\nIf unsure, default to \"complete\" — let the dispatcher handle it.\n\"#;\n\n/// Configuration for the Resolve strand.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct ResolveConfig {\n    /// Timeout in seconds for the LLM resolver call.\n    pub timeout_secs: u64,\n    /// Path to a custom resolve prompt template (optional).\n    pub custom_template_path: Option<PathBuf>,\n    /// Whether to use the default template when no custom template is provided.\n    pub use_default_template: bool,\n}\n\nimpl Default for ResolveConfig {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        ResolveConfig {\n            timeout_secs: 60,\n            custom_template_path: None,\n            use_default_template: true,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Structured response from the Resolve LLM call.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ResolveResponse {\n    /// The decision made.\n    pub decision: String,\n    /// Evidence supporting the decision.\n    pub evidence: String,\n    /// For \"retry\" decisions: how many seconds to wait before retry.\n    #[serde(default = \"default_retry_after\")]\n    pub retry_after_seconds: u64,\n    /// For \"blocked\" decisions: the ID of the blocking bead.\n    pub blocker_id: Option<String>,\n    /// For \"split\" decisions: explanation of why splitting is needed.\n    pub split_reason: Option<String>,\n}\n\nfn default_retry_after() -> u64 {\n    600\n}\n\n/// Validation result for a ResolveResponse.\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum ValidationResult {\n    /// Response is valid and can be parsed.\n    Valid {\n        decision: ResolveDecision,\n        outcome: ResolveOutcome,\n    },\n    /// Response is invalid or incomplete.\n    Invalid { reason: String },\n}\n\n/// The Resolve strand — post-Pluck decision analysis.\npub struct ResolveStrand {\n    /// Configuration for resolve behavior.\n    config: ResolveConfig,\n    /// Telemetry emitter.\n    telemetry: Telemetry,\n    /// Custom prompt template content (if loaded from file).\n    custom_template: Option<String>,\n}\n\nimpl ResolveStrand {\n    /// Create a new ResolveStrand with default configuration.\n    pub fn new(config: ResolveConfig, telemetry: Telemetry) -> Self {\n        let custom_template = if let Some(ref path) = config.custom_template_path {\n            // Try to load custom template\n            std::fs::read_to_string(path)\n                .ok()\n                .map(|s| s.trim().to_string())\n        } else {\n            None\n        };\n\n        ResolveStrand {\n            config,\n            telemetry,\n            custom_template,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Build the resolve prompt for a bead.\n    fn build_prompt(&self, bead: &Bead, workspace: &Path) -> Result<String> {\n        let template = if let Some(ref custom) = self.custom_template {\n            custom.as_str()\n        } else if self.config.use_default_template {\n            DEFAULT_RESOLVE_TEMPLATE\n        } else {\n            return Ok(String::new());\n        };\n\n        // Format dependencies\n        let dependencies = if bead.dependencies.is_empty() {\n            \"None\".to_string()\n        } else {\n            bead\n                .dependencies\n                .iter()\n                .map(|d| format!(\"- {} ({})\", d.id, d.dependency_type))\n                .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n                .join(\"\\n\")\n        };\n\n        // Format dependents\n        let dependents = if bead.dependents.is_empty() {\n            \"None\".to_string()\n        } else {\n            bead\n                .dependents\n                .iter()\n                .map(|d| format!(\"- {} ({})\", d.id, d.dependency_type))\n                .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n                .join(\"\\n\")\n        };\n\n        // Format labels\n        let labels = if bead.labels.is_empty() {\n            \"None\".to_string()\n        } else {\n            bead.labels.join(\", \")\n        };\n\n        // Format comments (truncated)\n        let comments = if bead.comments.is_empty() {\n            \"None\".to_string()\n        } else {\n            bead\n                .comments\n                .iter()\n                .take(3) // Only show most recent 3\n                .map(|c| {\n                    format!(\n                        \"- [{}] {}\",\n                        c.created_at.format(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M\"),\n                        c.text\n                    )\n                })\n                .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n                .join(\"\\n\")\n        };\n\n        let assignee = bead.assignee.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"unassigned\");\n\n        // Substitute variables\n        Ok(template\n            .replace(\"{bead_id}\", bead.id.as_ref())\n            .replace(\"{bead_title}\", &bead.title)\n            .replace(\"{bead_body}\", bead.body.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"(no description)\"))\n            .replace(\"{priority}\", &bead.priority.to_string())\n            .replace(\"{status}\", &format!(\"{:?}\", bead.status))\n            .replace(\"{assignee}\", assignee)\n            .replace(\"{labels}\", &labels)\n            .replace(\"{workspace_path}\", &workspace.display().to_string())\n            .replace(\"{dependency_count}\", &bead.dependencies.len().to_string())\n            .replace(\"{dependencies}\", &dependencies)\n            .replace(\"{dependent_count}\", &bead.dependents.len().to_string())\n            .replace(\"{dependents}\", &dependents)\n            .replace(\"{bead_comments}\", &comments))\n    }\n\n    /// Parse and validate the LLM response.\n    fn parse_response(&self, response_text: &str) -> ValidationResult {\n        // Strip markdown code fencing if present\n        let cleaned = response_text.trim().trim_start_matches(\"```json\").trim_end_matches(\"```\").trim();\n\n        // Parse JSON\n        let parsed: ResolveResponse = match serde_json::from_str(cleaned) {\n            Ok(r) => r,\n            Err(e) => {\n                return ValidationResult::Invalid {\n                    reason: format!(\"Failed to parse JSON response: {}\", e),\n                };\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Validate decision is one of the four allowed values\n        let decision = match parsed.decision.to_lowercase().as_str() {\n            \"complete\" => ResolveDecision::Complete,\n            \"retry\" => ResolveDecision::Retry,\n            \"blocked\" => ResolveDecision::Blocked,\n            \"split\" => ResolveDecision::Split,\n            _ => {\n                return ValidationResult::Invalid {\n                    reason: format!(\"Invalid decision value: {}\", parsed.decision),\n                };\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Build outcome based on decision\n        let outcome = match decision {\n            ResolveDecision::Complete => ResolveOutcome::Complete {\n                evidence: parsed.evidence.clone(),\n            },\n            ResolveDecision::Retry => ResolveOutcome::Retry {\n                evidence: parsed.evidence.clone(),\n                retry_after_seconds: parsed.retry_after_seconds,\n            },\n            ResolveDecision::Blocked => {\n                if let Some(blocker_id) = &parsed.blocker_id {\n                    ResolveOutcome::Blocked {\n                        evidence: parsed.evidence.clone(),\n                        blocker_id: BeadId::from(blocker_id.clone()),\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    return ValidationResult::Invalid {\n                        reason: \"Blocked decision requires blocker_id\".to_string(),\n                    };\n                }\n            }\n            ResolveDecision::Split => ResolveOutcome::Split {\n                evidence: parsed.evidence.clone(),\n                split_reason: parsed.split_reason.clone(),\n            },\n        };\n\n        ValidationResult::Valid { decision, outcome }\n    }\n\n    /// Invoke the LLM resolver.\n    async fn invoke_resolver(&self, prompt: &str) -> Result<Output> {\n        let timeout = Duration::from_secs(self.config.timeout_secs);\n\n        // Use claude as the default resolver (configurable in future)\n        let mut child = Command::new(\"claude\")\n            .arg(\"--message\")\n            .arg(prompt)\n            .stdout(Stdio::piped())\n            .stderr(Stdio::piped())\n `Success`\n    /// - exit 1 → `Failure`\n    /// - exit 124 → `Timeout`\n    /// - exit 127 → `AgentNotFound`\n    /// - exit >128 → `Crash(exit_code)`\n    /// - exit <0 → `Crash(exit_code)`\n    /// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// DecompositionMode\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Mode when a bead times out. The bead is decomposed\n///   into smaller child beads via `ChildBeadProposal`, each representing a\n///   phase of the original work. This is a recovery strategy for work that\n///   exceeded its time budget but may still be completable in smaller pieces.\n/// - **OrdinaryFailure mode**: Activated for any non-timeout failure (compilation\n///   error, test failure, agent crash, etc.). Returns `None` for `OrdinaryFailure` mode.\n    ///\n    /// # Examples\n    ///\n    /// ```\n    /// use needle::types::DecompositionMode;\n    ///\n    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n    ///     timeout_seconds: 120,\n    ///     current_phase_hint: None,\n    /// };\n    /// assert_eq!(mode.timeout_seconds(), Some(120));\n    ///\n    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::OrdinaryFailure;\n    /// assert_eq!(mode.timeout_seconds(), None);\n    /// ```\n    pub fn timeout_seconds(&self) -> Option<u64> {\n        match self {\n            DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n                timeout_seconds, ..\n            } => Some(*timeout_seconds),\n            DecompositionMode::OrdinaryFailure => None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the current phase hint if in timeout mode, None otherwise.\n    ///\n    /// This is a convenience method for extracting the optional phase hint\n    /// without pattern matching. Some(&\"Phase 1\".to_string()));\n    ///\n    /// let mode = DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n    ///     timeout_seconds: 120,\n    ///     current_phase_hint: None,\n    /// };\n    /// assert_eq!(mode.current_phase_hint(), None);\n    /// ```\n    pub fn current_phase_hint(&self) -> Option<&String> {\n        match self {\n            DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n                current_phase_hint, ..\n            } => current_phase_hint.as_ref(),\n            DecompositionMode::OrdinaryFailure => None,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl fmt::Display for DecompositionMode {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            DecompositionMode::Timeout {\n                timeout_seconds, ..\n            } => write!(f, \"timeout ({}s)\", timeout_seconds),\n            DecompositionMode::OrdinaryFailure => write!(f, \"ordinary_failure\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// StrandError / StrandResult\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Error returned by a strand evaluation.\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum StrandError {\n    StoreError(anyhow::Error),\n    ConfigError(String),\n}\n\nimpl fmt::Display for StrandError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            StrandError::StoreError(e) => {\n                // Show the full error chain, not just the top-level context.\n                // This surfaces the actual stderr/stdout from bf/br commands.\n                write!(f, \"bead store error: {}\", e)?;\n                // Append any error causes from the chain (the actual bf/br stderr)\n                for cause in e.chain().skip(1) {\n                    write!(f, \"\\n  caused by: {}\", cause)?;\n                }\n                Ok(())\n            }\n            StrandError::ConfigError(s) => write!(f, \"strand configuration error: {}\", s),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for StrandError {\n    fn source(&self) -> Option<&(dyn std::error::Error + 'static)> {\n        match self {\n            StrandError::StoreError(e) => Some(e.as_ref()),\n            StrandError::ConfigError(_) => None,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Result of a strand evaluation in the waterfall.\n#[non_exhaustive]\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum StrandResult {\n    /// One or more candidate beads were found.\n    BeadFound(Vec<Bead>),\n    /// The strand synthesized new work (e.g., mitosis created child beads).\n    WorkCreated,\n    /// This strand found nothing; continue to the next strand.\n    NoWork,\n    /// The strand encountered an error during evaluation.\n    Error(StrandError),\n    /// The strand was skipped because its prerequisites are not met.\n    ///\n    /// This is distinct from `NoWork` (which means \"ran and found nothing\")\n    /// and `Error` (which means \"ran but failed\"). `Skipped` means \"did not\n    /// run because the environment doesn't support it\" — e.g., a strand that\n    /// requires a home bead store when the worker is configured without one.\n    Skipped { reason: String },\n    /// A bead with too many consecutive failures should be split.\n    ///\n    /// Contains the bead to split and the current failure count.\n    Split(Box<Bead>, u32),\n    /// Candidates were found but all were excluded/assigned — short retry needed.\n    ///\n    /// This is distinct from `NoWork` (which means \"truly no candidates\").\n    /// `FoundButExcluded` means \"candidates exist but this worker can't claim\n    /// them right now\" — they're assigned to other workers or blocked by labels.\n    /// This signals the worker to use short retry backoff instead of long idle.\n    FoundButExcluded,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// ClaimResult / ClaimOutcome\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Result of a single claim attempt for one bead.\n#[non_exhaustive]\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub enum ClaimResult {\n    /// This worker successfully claimed the bead.\n    Claimed(Bead),\n    /// Another worker claimed the bead first.\n    RaceLost {\n        /// Assignee that won the race.\n        claimed_by: String,\n    },\n    /// The bead cannot be claimed (not open, blocked, etc.).\n    NotClaimable {\n        /// Human-readable reason.\n        reason: String,\n    },\n    /// Claim CLI failed with a store/CLI error (distinct from race-lost).\n    ClaimError {\n        /// Human-readable error message.\n        reason: String,\n    },\n    /// A claim error threshold was reached — bead/store is suspect.\n    ///\n    /// This variant is emitted when a bead has failed claim attempts N times\n    /// with errors (not race-lost conditions). The bead should be skipped and\n    /// marked as suspect rather than silently cycling.\n    Suspect {\n        /// The bead ID that hit the error threshold.\n        bead_id: BeadId,\n        /// The number of consecutive claim errors.\n        consecutive_errors: u32,\n        /// The most recent error message.\n        last_error: String,\n    },\n}\n\n/// Aggregate outcome after exhausting all candidates for a selection cycle.\n#[non_exhaustive]\n#[derive(Debug)]\n#[allow(clippy::large_enum_variant)]\npub enum ClaimOutcome {\n    /// Successfully claimed a bead.\n    Claimed(Bead),\n    /// Raced every candidate and lost every time.\n    AllRaceLost,\n    /// The strand returned no candidates.\n    NoCandidates,\n    /// The bead store returned an error.\n    StoreError(anyhow::Error),\n    /// A claim error threshold was reached — bead/store is suspect.\n    ///\n    /// This variant is emitted when a bead has failed claim attempts N times\n    /// with errors (not race-lost conditions). The bead should be skipped and\n    /// marked as suspect rather than silently cycling.\n    Suspect {\n        /// The bead ID that hit the error threshold.\n        bead_id: BeadId,\n        /// The number of consecutive claim errors.\n        consecutive_errors: u32,\n        /// The most recent error message.\n        last_error: String,\n    },\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// BrDependency\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// A bead dependency as returned from the `br`/`bf` JSON output, or from\n/// bead-rs's `bead` (`{\"blocker\": \"<id>\", \"kind\": \"blocks\"}` — a lean\n/// edge-only shape with no enriched title/status/priority). The aliases\n/// below accept both without changing how bf/br JSON deserializes.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct BrDependency {\n    #[serde(alias = \"blocker\")]\n    pub id: BeadId,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub title: String,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub status: String,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub priority: Priority,\n    #[serde(rename = \"dependency_type\", alias = \"kind\", default)]\n    pub dependency_type: String,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Bead struct\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Serde helper: treats an empty JSON string as `None`.\nfn empty_string_as_none<'de, D>(d: D) -> Result<Option<String>, D::Error>\nwhere\n    D: serde::Deserializer<'de>,\n{\n    let s = Option::<String>::deserialize(d)?;\n    Ok(s.filter(|s| !s.is_empty()))\n}\n\n/// A comment on a bead.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct Comment {\n    /// Comment ID (internal database ID).\n    pub id: i64,\n    /// The bead this comment is on.\n    #[serde(rename = \"issue_id\")]\n    pub bead_id: String,\n    /// The comment text.\n    pub text: String,\n    /// Author who created the comment.\n    pub author: String,\n    /// When the comment was created.\n    pub created_at: DateTime<Utc>,\n}\n\n/// A bead as returned from the bead store.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct Bead {\n    pub id: BeadId,\n    pub title: String,\n    /// Stored as `description` in br JSON output.\n    #[serde(rename = \"description\")]\n    pub body: Option<String>,\n    pub priority: Priority,\n    pub status: BeadStatus,\n    /// br emits `\"\"` for unassigned beads; normalize to `None`.\n    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = \"empty_string_as_none\")]\n    pub assignee: Option<String>,\n    /// br may omit this field when empty.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub labels: Vec<String>,\n    /// Stored as `source_repo` in br JSON output.\n    #[serde(rename = \"source_repo\", default)]\n    pub workspace: std::path::PathBuf,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub dependencies: Vec<BrDependency>,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub dependents: Vec<BrDependency>,\n    /// Comments on this bead, returned by `bf show --json`.\n    /// Empty array if no comments or backend doesn't support comments.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub comments: Vec<Comment>,\n    pub created_at: DateTime<Utc>,\n    // br ready --json omits updated_at; default to now so explore can deserialize it\n    #[serde(default = \"chrono::Utc::now\")]\n    pub updated_at: DateTime<Utc>,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// AgentOutcome\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Raw output from an agent process (before outcome classification).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct AgentOutcome {\n    pub exit_code: i32,\n    pub stdout: String,\n    pub stderr: String,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// NeedleError\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Top-level NEEDLE error type.\n///\n/// Tier is encoded in the variant, so recovery routing is type-driven.\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum NeedleError {\n    /// Transient: retry after backoff (network hiccup, lock contention).\n    Transient {\n        message: String,\n        bead_id: Option<BeadId>,\n    },\n    /// Bead-scoped: abandon this bead; other beads can proceed.\n    BeadScoped { message: String, bead_id: BeadId },\n    /// Worker-scoped: this worker should shut down; fleet continues.\n    WorkerScoped {\n        message: String,\n        worker_id: WorkerId,\n    },\n}\n\nimpl fmt::Display for NeedleError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            NeedleError::Transient {\n                message,\n                bead_id: Some(id),\n            } => {\n                write!(f, \"transient error (bead {}): {}\", id, message)\n            }\n            NeedleError::Transient {\n                message,\n                bead_id: None,\n            } => {\n                write!(f, \"transient error: {}\", message)\n            }\n            NeedleError::BeadScoped { message, bead_id } => {\n                write!(f, \"bead-scoped error (bead {}): {}\", bead_id, message)\n            }\n            NeedleError::WorkerScoped { message, worker_id } => {\n                write!(f, \"worker-scoped error (worker {}): {}\", worker_id, message)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for NeedleError {}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// InputMethod\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// How the prompt is passed to the agent binary.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\n#[serde(tag = \"method\", rename_all = \"snake_case\")]\npub enum InputMethod {\n    /// Write the prompt to the agent's stdin.\n    Stdin,\n    /// Write the prompt to a temp file and pass the path.\n    File {\n        /// Template for the temp file path. `{bead_id}` is substituted.\n        path_template: String,\n    },\n    /// Pass the prompt as a CLI argument.\n    Args {\n        /// Flag name (e.g., `--prompt`).\n        flag: String,\n    },\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// HeartbeatFile / PeerStatus\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Path reference to a worker's heartbeat file on disk.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct HeartbeatFile {\n    pub path: std::path::PathBuf,\n}\n\n/// Health status of a peer worker as inferred from its heartbeat file.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub enum PeerStatus {\n    /// Heartbeat is fresh — peer is considered assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(100, false), Outcome::Failure); // NOT timeout per spec\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(123, false), Outcome::Failure);\n        // 125-126 -> Failure (not assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(-1, false), Outcome::Crash(-1));\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(-9, false), Outcome::Crash(-9));\n        // Large positive values >255 -> Crash per spec (exit > 128)\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(256, false), Outcome::Crash(256));\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(1000, false), Outcome::Crash(1000));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(125, false), Outcome::Failure);\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(126, false), Outcome::Failure);\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(127, false), Outcome::AgentNotFound);\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(128, false), Outcome::Failure);\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(129, false), Outcome::Crash(129)); // First crash code\n\n        // i32 extremes\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(i32::MAX, false), Outcome::Crash(i32::MAX));\n        assert_eq!(Outcome::classify(i32::MIN, false), Outcome::Crash(i32::MIN));\n    }\n\n %context.bead.id,\n494\t                    error = %e,\n495\t                    \"resolver: failed to build prompt, using fallback\"\n496\t                );\n497\t                return \"resolver: binary identity verification failed, using fallback\"\n516\t            );\n517\t            return ResolveDecision::Retry {\n518\t                reason: format!(\"Binary identity
